observations.code_quote: - `kickout_count` counts merge-queue gate attempts where any workflow run failed. A queue removes a pull request only when a check it requires fails, and the GitHub source does not record which checks those are, so a failed optional check also counts. The figure is an upper bound on queue removals. The column keeps its name because saved queries over the view select it.
